walkthrough.formula: Take any model M of the premises.
walkthrough.explanation: The picture shows only the object named Socrates. M may contain other objects.
The second premise puts this object in the extension of Human.
The universal premise applies to every object of M, including the object named Socrates.
Human(Socrates) is true. For the conditional to be true, Mortal(Socrates) must be true too. We can now add that membership to the picture.
We chose an arbitrary model of the premises. The same reasoning works in every such model.
